name: mucous cloud
desc:
While underwater, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.
